<?php
$running = null;
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    global $running;
    echo (int)$running(), '|';
    echo Fiber::suspend('S'), '|';
    return 23;
});
$started = $f->isStarted(...);
$suspended = $f->isSuspended(...);
$running = $f->isRunning(...);
$terminated = $f->isTerminated(...);
$get = $f->getReturn(...);
$name = 'ReSuMe';
$resume = $f->$name(...);
$name = 'missing';
echo (int)$started(), (int)$suspended(), (int)$running(), (int)$terminated(), '|';
echo $f->start(), '|', (int)$started(), (int)$suspended(), '|';
echo (int)($resume(...['value' => 'R']) === null), '|';
echo (int)$started(), (int)$suspended(), (int)$running(), (int)$terminated(), '|', $get();

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    Fiber::suspend();
    throw new RuntimeException('X');
});
$f->start();
$resume = $f->resume(...);
try { $resume->__invoke(value: 'R'); }
catch (RuntimeException $error) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo $error->getMessage(), '|', $trace[1]['function'], $trace[1]['type'], '|';
    echo $trace[2]['class'], $trace[2]['function'];
}

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {});
$capture = $f->isStarted(...);
echo 'P|';
$child = new Fiber($capture);
echo (int)$child->start();

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () { return 7; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($f);
$name = 'iSsTaRtEd';
$a = $f->$name(...);
$name = 'missing';
$b = $f->isStarted(...);
$copy = clone $a;
$invoke = $a->__invoke(...);
$g = new Fiber(static function () {});
$other = $g->isStarted(...);
echo (int)($a == $b), (int)($a !== $b), (int)($a == $copy), (int)($invoke === $a), (int)($a == $other), '|';
unset($f, $a, $b, $copy);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), (int)$invoke(), '|';
unset($invoke);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$f->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($f);
$capture = $f->isSuspended(...);
unset($f);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|', (int)$capture(), '|';
unset($capture);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$weakClosure = null;
$weakFiber = null;
class BoundArgument19 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weakClosure, $weakFiber;
        echo 'D', (int)($weakClosure->get() !== null), (int)($weakFiber->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
function dropBoundCapture19() {
    global $capture;
    $capture = null;
    return new BoundArgument19;
}
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); echo 'B|'; Fiber::suspend(); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$f->start();
$capture = $f->resume(...);
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($capture);
$weakFiber = WeakReference::create($f);
unset($f);
$capture(dropBoundCapture19());
echo (int)($weakClosure->get() === null), (int)($weakFiber->get() === null);

<?php
$weakClosure = null;
$weakFiber = null;
class BoundInvokeArgument19 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weakClosure, $weakFiber;
        echo 'D', (int)($weakClosure->get() !== null), (int)($weakFiber->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
function dropBoundInvokeCapture19() {
    global $capture;
    $capture = null;
    return new BoundInvokeArgument19;
}
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); echo 'B|'; Fiber::suspend(); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$f->start();
$capture = $f->resume(...);
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($capture);
$weakFiber = WeakReference::create($f);
unset($f);
$capture->__invoke(value: dropBoundInvokeCapture19());
echo (int)($weakClosure->get() === null), (int)($weakFiber->get() === null);

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend('S'); }
    catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'C', $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
    return 17;
});
echo $f->start(), '|';
$throw = $f->throw(...);
$get = $f->getReturn(...);
$weak = WeakReference::create($f);
unset($f);
echo (int)($throw(exception: new RuntimeException('X')) === null), '|', $get(), '|';
unset($throw, $get);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$child = new Fiber(static function () { Fiber::suspend(); echo 'C|'; Fiber::suspend(); return 19; });
$child->start();
$resume = $child->resume(...);
$running = $child->isRunning(...);
$suspended = $child->isSuspended(...);
$parent = new Fiber(static function () use ($resume, $running, $suspended) {
    echo 'P|';
    $resume();
    echo (int)$running(), (int)$suspended(), '|';
    Fiber::suspend();
    $resume();
});
$parent->start();
echo (int)$child->isSuspended(), '|';
$parent->resume();
echo $child->getReturn();

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {});
$resume = $f->resume(...);
$throw = $f->throw(...);
try { $resume(nope: 1); } catch (Error $error) { echo 'N|'; }
try { $resume(1, 2); } catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'A|'; }
try { $resume(); } catch (FiberError $error) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo $trace[0]['function'], $trace[0]['type'], '|';
}
try { $throw(exception: 1); } catch (TypeError $error) { echo 'T|'; }
try { $throw(); } catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'M|'; }
try { $resume->__invoke(); } catch (FiberError $error) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo $trace[0]['function'], $trace[0]['type'], '/', $trace[1]['class'], $trace[1]['function'];
}

<?php
class BoundIdle337 {
    public $self;
    function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }
    function __destruct() {
        $GLOBALS['worker'] = Fiber::getCurrent();
        echo 'D|';
    }
}
$request = new Fiber(static function () {
    $cycle = new BoundIdle337();
    unset($cycle);
    echo gc_collect_cycles(), '|';
});
$request->start();
unset($request);
$resume = $worker->resume(...);
$throw = $worker->throw(...);
$suspended = $worker->isSuspended(...);
unset($worker);
echo (int)($resume(value: 123) === null), '|';
try { $throw->__invoke(exception: new Exception('idle')); }
catch (Exception $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
unset($error);
echo (int)$suspended(), '|';
unset($resume, $throw, $suspended);
echo 'END';
